title: Cipher telegrams to Setembrino de Carvalho, Ceará 1914 (catalogue 1470): key MFTDBSJV telegrams read, 10 March and 20 May provisional

steps.what: Daniel Bourdeau finds the system and rebuilds MFTDBSJV from the pencil decipherment of pagfis 1319; trial readings of six telegrams; LETCARIV for 10 March (research/latam_vetting/1470_sample.txt).

Blind transcription and pre-registration frozen by hash; MFTDBSJV fixed on pagfis 1319 alone, measured on 731 held-out letters: 0.733 with the pre-registered lexicon (criterion 0.85 not met), 0.865 with the declared post-hoc lexicon amendment, vs max 0.129 for 2000 controls.
All telegrams in key MFTDBSJV read: 1043 cipher letters, 97.2%; 10 March (LETCARIV) and 20 May (new key OVHXZIRF, ciphertext-only) read provisionally; whole file 1440 letters, 95.8%.

Integration check by an independent session: own decoder from key.tsv gives 242 of 243 mechanical groups identical (the one difference is OJTUB, shown from the sheet's service note); strict count by cipher group from reading_count.md: key MFTDBSJV 168 of 182 = 92.3%, file 201 of 240 = 83.8%; MRELDTKRIMV and SUQHSJU tried under every rotation of the four known keys (MFTDBSJV, LETCARIV, OVHXZIRF, LBQPOHVJ): no word. The pre-registered test result (0.733, failed) is kept as failed.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: Key MFTDBSJV rebuilt from the contemporary pencil decipherment on the sheet of 14 March 1914 (pagfis 1319): first by Daniel Bourdeau, then re-derived by the contributor on that sheet alone; the 20 May key OVHXZIRF was found from the ciphertext alone and 10 March uses a near variant of the same key (both provisional).
outcome.fraction_read_source: Integration count by cipher group (the README unit is words), from the markers in reading_count.md: 240 cipher groups, 201 read without a restored letter, a probable letter or an unresolved group = 83.8%. Key MFTDBSJV telegrams: 182 groups, 168 sure = 92.3% (93% with the one probable group). The contributor's own count is by cipher letter: 1440 letters, 1377 sure + 3 probable = 95.8%; key MFTDBSJV 1043 letters, 97.2%.

validation.notes: The contributor's pre-registered held-out test of MFTDBSJV FAILED: fixed on pagfis 1319, measured on 731 held-out letters (18 March + 17 April), S = 0.733 against the 0.85 criterion (controls at most 0.097). A larger lexicon chosen by rule after that result (amendment A1, declared post hoc) gives 0.865 against at most 0.129 for 2000 controls; that is a changed rule, not a pass of the test. The key is credible on other evidence: the contemporary pencil decipherment on pagfis 1319 agrees at every key position, and the held-out telegrams read as continuous Portuguese. LETCARIV (93 letters) and OVHXZIRF (held-out 152 letters, S = 0.546) did not reach the criterion either. Contributor's own test, not docs/_validate.py; the scripts and the lexicon are not in the repository.

texts.label: Cipher telegrams Rio de Janeiro -> Fortaleza, 10 March - 20 May 1914 (FSC pce 1914.03.10/4)
texts.summary: Telegrams to Col./Gen. Setembrino de Carvalho, federal commander at Fortaleza during the Juazeiro sedition, from the Minister of War Vespasiano de Albuquerque, his aide-de-camp and son-in-law Rego Barros, and E. Pamplona: reports that Governor Franco Rabelo's palace was mined and the engineer's account of the works under it, Ceará faction politics (Thomaz Cavalcanti, Liberato), telegraph staff, the Pernambuco judge and the Supreme Court, and a reserved warning on 20 May that the Minister was displeased by a cipher telegraph conversation.

reading_review.note: Read as sentences 12 Nov 2026 against translation.md: coherent telegraphic Portuguese of 1914 throughout the MFTDBSJV telegrams (palace mining report, no. 52414 in full, Pinheiro, Andrade Fortuna, Gonçalo Souto, Pernambuco judge). Unresolved: MRELDTKRIMV (1326), SUQHSJU (1328). Grade B because 10 March and 20 May rest on keys not validated and need many slip corrections. Integration check: the sentences read; by cipher groups 83.8% of the file and 92.3% of the MFTDBSJV telegrams, so read in part.

outcome.notes: Read in part (corrected 12 Nov 2026; the PR said read with limited reserves). By the README rule, in cipher groups, the telegrams in key MFTDBSJV are 92.3% (the contributor's 97.2% is a letter count) and the file 83.8%; the contributor's letter counts are kept once, labelled theirs. (a) The pre-registered test of MFTDBSJV failed (0.733 < 0.85); the 0.865 comes from a larger lexicon chosen after the result. (b) 10 March (LETCARIV) and 20 May (OVHXZIRF) are provisional. (c) Two groups are unread: MRELDTKRIMV and SUQHSJU. Order of events (frozen hashes, single commits) is by the contributor's record.

prior.where: Contemporary pencil decipherment of the 14 March telegram; Daniel Bourdeau's vetting (research/latam_vetting/1470_sample.txt, 28 Oct and 3 Nov 2026): system, key MFTDBSJV, LETCARIV, trial readings of most March-April telegrams.
